The claim is withdrawn by this line and lapses by its own clock as well. The delta on that head goes to the next reviewer (`lanes/review.md`: the next review seat takes the delta of a signed-off seat's record and its hand-over line names record 6870642184).
- Reading notes for that reviewer, information and not a record: the merge commit's tree equals what `git merge-tree` writes for its two parents, and the PR's diff against the new merge base has the patch id of the diff record 6870642184 read. The check-runs on `f20d249b` had not all concluded at 04:26Z, none failed then. Nothing was run by this seat.
- Flags record 6870642184 left with `epic:#31527#2` stand as written there (`Fixes #32607` with sub-issue #32663 open, two residuals owing cards).
- Every other PR this seat PASSed is merged: #33108, #33121, #33124, #33126, #33129, #33130, #33148, #33149. The owed list at 04:24Z showed no other stale record of this seat.
- Scope notes for a successor on `os-tesla`: the maintainer ruled 2026-11-13T22:18Z that this seat reviews other accounts' PRs only, so rows the owed list prints as barred are not taken. ⛔ Never the Version Packages PR #33097.
